spanish: Y lo verá el sacerdote, y he aquí elevación blanca rojiza de la plaga en su calva o en su frente calva, como apariencia de lepra de piel de carne.
grammarChanges: Moved the feminine adjectives 'blanca rojiza' to modify 'elevación' (matching feminine שְׂאֵת) instead of 'la plaga' (masculine הַנֶּגַע).
Translated the common noun צָרַעַת, left as the bare lemma 'tsaráat', as 'lepra'.
Replaced generic 'calvicie' with 'calva' so קָרַחַת (crown/back-of-head baldness) is distinct from 'frente calva' (גַבַּחַת, forehead baldness).
readerNote: Chose lepra for tsaráat and calva (vs. frente calva) for קָרַחַת/גַבַּחַת since the packet gave no gloss for either term.
